note: Entity Pager provides a single Views style plugin (id 'entity_pager', class Drupal\entity_pager\Plugin\views\style\EntityPager) that renders prev/All/next navigation on an entity's canonical page from a View listing the sibling entities. No configure route (configure=null), no settings form, no permissions, no Drush. Its only persistent state is each View's style config: views.view.<id> -> display.<d>.display_options.style (type + options link_prev/link_next/link_all_url/link_all_text/display_all/display_count/circular_paging/show_disabled_links/relationship). A demo View 'entity_pager_example' ships DISABLED with a block display 'entity_pager_example_block'. Medium cases enable that demo View and set sentinel style options for the agent to read back; hard cases toggle circular_paging on the demo View and build a new View that uses the entity_pager style. Depends on core Views only.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I want Next/Previous links on each Article node's page so visitors can walk through the articles. The entity_pager module is installed. Which Views format/style do I select, and does entity_pager have its own admin settings page?
evals.expected_output: Build a View (usually a block display) listing the entities, then set its Format/style to 'Entity Pager' (style plugin id entity_pager). There is no admin settings page (configure=null); all options live in the View's style settings and it depends on core Views.

evals.prompt: In the entity_pager Views style, which option makes the pager wrap around so that clicking 'next' on the last item goes to the first item (and 'prev' on the first goes to the last)?
evals.expected_output: The 'Circular paging' style option (config key circular_paging: true) wraps last->first and first->last. When it is off, the ends show disabled links if 'show_disabled_links' is on.

evals.prompt: With the entity_pager Views style, how do I make the middle 'All' link point to a page derived from the current entity, e.g. a referenced company, and show that company's title as the link text?
evals.expected_output: Set the 'All link URL' (link_all_url) and 'All link label' (link_all_text) to a token that relates to the entity, e.g. an entity-reference token like [node:field_company]; putting the same reference token in the label box auto-renders the referenced entity's title. Tokens are replaced against the current entity.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an enabled View that uses the Entity Pager style. Inspect the live Views configuration and report the exact text configured as the Next-link label on that View's default display.
evals.expected_output: The entity_pager_example View's default display uses the entity_pager style with link_next set to 'EP_NEXT_SENTINEL_42 >' (read from views.view.entity_pager_example -> display.default.display_options.style.options.link_next).

evals.prompt: An enabled View on this site uses the Entity Pager style with circular paging turned on. Inspect the live configuration and report the label text configured for the middle 'All' link on its default display.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.entity_pager_example -> display.default.display_options.style.options, circular_paging is TRUE and link_all_text is 'EP_ALL_SENTINEL_77'.

evals.prompt: This site has an enabled View 'entity_pager_example' whose default display uses the Entity Pager style. Turn ON circular paging for that display (so the pager wraps last->first) and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set display.default.display_options.style.options.circular_paging to TRUE on views.view.entity_pager_example and save (e.g. via the View entity API or drush).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a View with the machine name 'ep_task_view' that uses the Entity Pager style (the entity_pager Views style plugin) on one of its displays, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A view config entity 'ep_task_view' exists with at least one display whose display_options.style.type === 'entity_pager'.
